summary: Executed backend + frontend regression for one-button welcome flow on public preview URL. Backend public APIs passed (8/8). Frontend validated: login screen has exactly one enabled Login button, no email/password fields, keyboard Enter login works, no /api/auth/login calls, no Authorization headers, sessionStorage reload persistence works, invalid qlub_token ignored, blocked sessionStorage get/set still allows welcome + entry, all five sections navigate, Expo search/filter and VoC filters smoke pass, mobile nav toggle behavior works. Remaining issue: LA map pin descendants still render outside viewport bounds on mobile though document-level horizontal scrolling is fixed.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 390x844, multiple map pin descendants render beyond viewport right edge (e.g., Pasadena/Highland Park/Chinatown pins), despite container clipping.

issues: Pin label wrappers with min width and centered translate positioning can overflow visual viewport near map edges.
Document horizontal scroll is no longer present (doc/body scrollWidth equals viewport width), so issue is now localized to map-pin rendering bounds.

action_items: Clamp pin label positions at map edges in LADensityMap so pin wrappers cannot render beyond viewport (especially right edge).
Apply minimal edge-aware offset/anchor logic for labels near boundaries (e.g., switch from centered to left/right anchored when x is near 0% or 100%).
Retest mobile map at 390x844 after pin-boundary fix to confirm no out-of-viewport descendants remain.
critical_code_review_comments: LADensityMap uses absolute pins with transform: translate(-50%, -100%) plus min-w label blocks; edge pins can exceed viewport bounds even when shell overflow is fixed.
Frontend API layer still exposes api.login helper, but tested flows correctly avoid invoking /api/auth/login under the new one-button welcome step.
No token/Authorization coupling observed in dashboard data fetches; public API integration remains aligned with no-auth welcome behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested flows pass; mobile map-pin edge overflow remains)

rca of the issue: Repro: open app on mobile 390x844 -> Login -> Overview -> inspect LA map pins. Root cause: pin wrapper is centered at projected x coordinate and label card has fixed min width; near-edge neighborhoods exceed viewport despite map container clipping. Mitigation: introduce edge-aware pin anchoring/clamping logic for x positions close to map boundaries and/or responsive label width constraints.
